name: Lunatics Wish
original_name: ルナティクス・ヴィッシュ
source:
The princess of the country of Luna, whose kingdom was destroyed by King Bria, who was turned into a demon by Princess Sara. She was originally engaged to Bria, but her kingdom was destroyed by King Bria, causing her to lose faith in humanity. She has the ability to read people's minds, and is skilled in both sword and magic.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071215205316fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/da/char03.html]Mink[/url]]
